name: webapp-harness
description: Install and operate a deterministic sequential web-application development harness with evidence-backed backlog generation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and complete verified sequential backlogs.
interface.longDescription: Install a repository-native harness, audit evidence-backed gaps into a user-confirmed backlog, then process ready tasks sequentially through implementation, verification, browser validation, review, and per-task commits until complete.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the development harness and preview its first evidence-backed backlog.
Audit this repository for gaps and propose backlog tasks for my confirmation.
Run the verified backlog sequentially until it is complete.
